title: Master of Magic
build: Remember's crack, release 15: cracked from tape, docs by HOK, +2 trainer by Jack Alien; one file, M.OF MAGIC+2/REM, on a disk named C64.COM. The game starts at $07F9 and runs with no trainer option taken

tools.emulator: VICE 3.10 via vice-mcp 3.13.0: own build of github.com/barryw/vice-mcp, branch main, commit 00b275f2 (Linux x86_64 GTK3 build from source, run under Xvfb)
tools.host: Linux 6.18 x86_64, Ubuntu 24.04 cloud container with four cores and no display

exclude: BASIC ROM entry the game calls (RAM initialisation, from $0809); the RAM beneath is title data, counted under its own labels
KERNAL ROM entry the game calls (clear screen, from $0806); the RAM beneath is title data
KERNAL ROM interrupt exit the play and title handlers jump to; the RAM beneath is title data
KERNAL ROM entry the game calls (CHROUT); the RAM beneath is title data

regions: the dungeon map, four levels side by side
the picture strip's bitmap and pillars
the music driver and three tunes
the title picture's bitmap, under the KERNAL ROM
the title scroller, the controls and instruction pages
leftover code of a machine-code monitor, never run
